Full skill text at 7★
At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants all allies 1 layer of [Spirit Flame]: Will be converted to [Celestial Inferno] (increases [Burn] DMG dealt by 2.6%, up to 20 layers.) after dealing Burn DMG or inflicting [Burn]. When there are multiple [Spirit Flame] and [Celestial Inferno], only the strongest one will take effect([Celestial Inferno] will not be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.). Each layer of [Celestial Inferno] also increases Skill DMG by 1.5%. At the beginning of the owner's turn, reclaims the newly converted [Celestial Inferno] and copies them to other allies. This effect will not be triggered when the layers of [Celestial Inferno] reach the upper limit.
Source: game files.

Effects

  • [Spirit Flame] — Will be converted to [Celestial Inferno] after dealing [Burn] DMG or inflicting [Burn].
  • [Burn] — Takes DMG by 50% of the inflictor's ATK each turn before action. Will be detonated and then removed when stacking 2 layers, which deals DMG by 300% of the inflictor’s ATK. Burn DMG ignores DEF and cannot trigger Crit, Leech and DMG Reflect effects.
  • [Celestial Inferno] — Increases [Burn] DMG dealt by a certain amount.
